_comment: Development set of the symptom paraphrase regression (stage 2). Each group is one problem described in different words. phrases[0] is the reference: every other phrase must yield the same planned-check set as it, and the group's expected_class. The held-out quarter lives in symptom_paraphrases_heldout.json and is not used while tuning the classifier.
